Horry County South Carolina Inmate Lookup

If you need to locate an inmate in Horry County, South Carolina, there are several official resources available to help you find current custody information. Whether someone has been recently arrested or you need to verify their location within the jail system, a horry county south carolina inmate lookup can be completed through multiple channels. This guide provides detailed steps, official resources, and answers to common questions about accessing inmate records.

How to Search Horry County Jail Records

  1. Visit the official Horry County Sheriff's Office inmate search website or database to check current jail population records.
  2. Enter the inmate's full name, booking number, or date of birth into the search system. First and last names are typically required.
  3. Review the search results, which should display the inmate's custody status, charges, booking date, and bail information if available.
  4. Note the inmate's booking number for future reference when contacting the jail or arranging visitation.
  5. If the inmate is not found in Horry County records, check the South Carolina Department of Corrections database for state-level inmates.
  6. Contact the Horry County Sheriff's Office directly by phone if you cannot locate the inmate online or need additional information.
  7. Request court records from Horry County if you need details about charges, arraignment dates, or case status.

Bail Bond Information for Horry County

When someone is arrested in Horry County, bail or bond may be set during an initial appearance or arraignment hearing. In many cases, individuals can work with bail bond agents to secure release before trial. Most bail bondsmen in Horry County operate on a standard fee structure, typically charging 10% of the total bail amount as a non-refundable fee. This means if bail is set at $5,000, you would pay the bondsman $500 to post the full bail amount with the court. Licensed bail bond professionals can often expedite the release process and explain payment options available to families.

The arraignment typically occurs within 24 to 72 hours of arrest, depending on whether the arrest occurred on a weekend or holiday. During this hearing, the judge reviews the charges and sets bail or bond conditions. If bail is set and you use a bondsman, the process of posting bond and securing release can usually happen within hours. Some arrestees may be released on their own recognizance without bail, while others may face higher amounts or be held without bail if deemed a flight risk or danger to the community.

Visitation Rules at Horry County Jail

  • Inmate Identification: Have the inmate's full name and booking number ready before scheduling a visit.
  • Visitation Hours: Horry County Jail typically allows visitation during specific weekday and weekend hours; contact the facility to confirm current schedules.
  • Dress Code: Visitors must follow strict dress code guidelines, including no revealing clothing, gang affiliations, or items that could pose security risks.
  • Video Visitation: The facility offers video visitation options for those unable to visit in person, available through scheduled appointments.
  • Children Policy: Children may be permitted to visit with prior approval, but all visitors, including minors, must follow facility rules and security procedures.

What to Expect After Arrest in Horry County

  1. Booking Process: The arrestee is brought to the Horry County Jail where personal information, charges, and background details are recorded into the system.
  2. Medical Screening: A medical evaluation is conducted to identify any health conditions, medications, or mental health concerns requiring accommodation.
  3. Classification and Housing: Based on charge severity, criminal history, and behavioral assessment, inmates are classified and assigned to appropriate housing units.
  4. Initial Appearance and Arraignment: Within 24 to 72 hours, the inmate appears before a judge for charges to be read and bail or bond to be determined.
  5. Transfer or Release: The inmate may be released on bail or bond, transferred to a state facility, or held pending trial depending on court decisions.

How to Contact Horry County Jail

Direct communication with Horry County Jail staff can provide real-time information about a specific inmate's location, charges, and custody status. Phone inquiries are often the fastest way to verify that someone has been booked into the facility or to ask about visitation procedures. You can also send written inquiries or visit in person during business hours, though calling ahead is recommended to ensure you reach the correct department.
